consent_string: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{

},
{
value: ctx.messageType === 'gdpr' ? (ctx.euconsent ?? null) : null,
source: 'onConsentReady.euconsent',
},
{ value: getCookie('euconsent-v2'), source: 'cookie.euconsent-v2' },
],
applies: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{

{
value:

},

uuid: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'uuid']),

{

{ value: getCookie('usnatUUID'), source: 'cookie.usnatUUID' },

{

{

<script id="ads-bordeaux-script" type="text/javascript">
window.bordeaux = window.bordeaux || {};
window.bordeaux.cmd = window.bordeaux.cmd || [];
window.champagne = window.champagne || {};
window.champagne.cmd = window.champagne.cmd || [];
window.ffte.bordeaux ={
pageTemplate: "listing",
adParameters: window.adParameters || {"site":"windowscentral","content":"unknown","type":"unsponsored-listing"}
};
(function() {
const QA_BASE_URL = 'public.rtb-qa-eks-euw1.futureplc.engineering';
const createScriptTag = (src) => {
const script = document.createElement('script');
script.setAttribute('src', src);
script.setAttribute('onerror', 'handleHeaderError()');
script.setAttribute('crossorigin', 'anonymous');
script.defer = true;
return script;
};
const appendScriptTags = (qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion) => {
if (window.disableBordeaux === true) return;
const bordeauxUrl = qaBordeauxVersion
? `https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js?version=${qaBordeauxVersion}`
: 'https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js';
const champagneUrl = qaChampagneVersion
? `https://chmp.${qaChampagneVersion}.${QA_BASE_URL}/champagne.js`
: 'https://champagne.futurecdn.net/champagne.js';
document.head.append(
createScriptTag(bordeauxUrl),
createScriptTag(champagneUrl)
);
};
const getQueryParams = () => {
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
return {
qaBordeauxVersion: params.get('hybrid_bordeaux_version') ?? null,
qaChampagneVersion: params.get('hybrid_champagne_version') ?? null,
};
};
const { qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion } = getQueryParams();
appendScriptTags(qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion);
if (qaBordeauxVersion) {
window.bordeaux.cmd.push(() => window.bordeaux.setAdToolVersion(qaBordeauxVersion));
}
})();
</script>

const match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)_lr_geo_location=([^;]*)/);
return match && match[1] === 'US';
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
/* --- CONDITIONAL UX HANDLING (US vs ROW) --- */
const isUS = isUSUser();
const marketingConsentLabel = document.getElementById('marketingConsentLabelBanner');
const legalTermsBanner = document.getElementById('legalTermsBanner');
if (isUS) {
/* For the US: hide the checkbox and update the full disclaimer */
if (marketingConsentLabel) {
marketingConsentLabel.style.display = 'none';
}
if (legalTermsBanner) {
legalTermsBanner.innerHTML = `By submitting your information, you confirm you are aged 16 or over, have read our <a href="https://futureplc.com/privacy-policy/" target="_blank" class="flcw-text-popup underline">Privacy Policy</a> and agree to the <a href="https://futureplc.com/terms-conditions/" target="_blank" class="flcw-text-popup underline">Terms & Conditions</a>. Geographical rules apply. You also agree to receive marketing emails from us that may include promotions from our trusted partners and sponsors, which you can unsubscribe from at any time.`;
}
} else {
/* For Non-US: ensure the text exactly matches the Acceptance Criteria */
if (legalTermsBanner) {
legalTermsBanner.innerHTML = `By submitting your information you agree to the <a href="https://futureplc.com/terms-conditions/" target="_blank" class="flcw-text-popup underline">Terms & Conditions</a> and <a href="https://futureplc.com/privacy-policy/" target="_blank" class="flcw-text-popup underline">Privacy Policy</a> and are aged 16 or over.`;
}
}
/* --------------------------------------------- */
const banner = document.getElementById('skinnyBanner');
if (!banner) return;
const isJumpLinksViewport = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1279px)').matches;
const suppressForJumpLinks = banner.dataset.suppressForJumpLinks === 'true';
if (isJumpLinksViewport && suppressForJumpLinks) {
banner.classList.remove('show', 'expanded');
banner.style.display = 'none';
document.body.classList.remove('banner-visible', 'banner-expanded');
return;
}
const isAuthKiosq = window.FUTR?.Kiosq?.User?.is_authenticated;
const isAuthConnect = window.FUTR?.Connect?.Auth?.kiosqUserIsAuthenticated;
if ((isAuthKiosq || isAuthConnect) && sessionStorage.getItem('membership_redirect_pending') === 'true') {
sessionStorage.removeItem('membership_redirect_pending');
window.location.href = '/membership';
return;
}
const bannerHeader = document.getElementById('bannerHeader');
const joinNowBtn = document.getElementById('joinNowBtn');
const emailInput = document.querySelector("#membershipSignUp #emailInput");
const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
const formElement = document.getElementById("membershipSignUp");
const authFeedback = document.getElementById("authFeedback");
let bannerVisible = false;
let bannerExpanded = false;
let bannerDismissed = localStorage.getItem('skinnyBannerDismissed') === 'true';
let isInputFocused = false;
let isLoginMode = false;
function getCookieValueBis(name) {
const v = document.cookie.match('(^|;) ?' + name + '=([^;]*)(;|$)');
return v ? v[2] : null;
}
function submitRedirection() {
sessionStorage.setItem('membership_just_signed_up', 'true');
window.location.href = '/membership';
}
if (emailInput) {
emailInput.addEventListener('focus', () => { isInputFocused = true; });
emailInput.addEventListener('blur', () => { isInputFocused = false; });
emailInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
if(isLoginMode) {
isLoginMode = false;
submitBtn.value = "SIGN UP";
if (authFeedback) authFeedback.classList.add('hidden');
submitBtn.disabled = false;
}
if(window.dispatchOrQueueAction) {
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'membershipEvent',
eventObject: { membership: { action: "input-signup-form", label: "user-personal-data", type: "banner-sticky" } }
});
}
});
}
if (formElement) {
formElement.addEventListener("submit", async function (event) {
event.preventDefault();
if (!emailInput.value.trim()) { emailInput.focus(); return; }
if (isLoginMode) {
if (window.FUTR?.Connect?.Auth?.login) {
window.FUTR.Connect.Auth.login();
submitRedirection();
}
return;
}
submitBtn.disabled = true;
if(window.dispatchOrQueueAction) {
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'membershipEvent',
eventObject: { membership: { action: "signup-form-submit", label: 'user-personal-data', type: "hero-banner" } }
});
}
const formData = new FormData(this);
let jsonData = { submission: {} };
const kiosqId = window.FUTR?.Kiosq?.User?.sub ?? null;
const gaId = getCookieValueBis('_ga');
const hybridId = (window.bordeaux?.hybridId) || getCookieValueBis('h_id');
const blueconicId = (window.blueConicClient?.profile?.getProfile()?.getId()) || getCookieValueBis('BCSessionID');
const userIds = [
{ type: 'TYPE_KIOSQ', value: kiosqId },
{ type: 'TYPE_GA', value: gaId },
{ type: 'TYPE_HYBRID', value: hybridId },
{ type: 'TYPE_BLUECONIC', value: blueconicId}
].filter((id) => id.value && typeof id.value === 'string');
formData.forEach((value, key) => { jsonData.submission[key] = value; });
/* --- US BUSINESS LOGIC FOR MARKETING CONSENT --- */
const marketingCheckbox = document.getElementById('CONTACT_OTHER_BRANDS');
let hasMarketingConsent = false;
const isUserUS = isUSUser();
if (isUserUS) {
/* Automatic opt-in for the US */
hasMarketingConsent = true;
} else {
/* Manual opt-in for the rest of the world */
hasMarketingConsent = marketingCheckbox ? marketingCheckbox.checked : false;
}
jsonData.submission['consent'] = {
'marketing': hasMarketingConsent,
'data': false
};
/* Adding consent audit data required by the Acceptance Criteria */
jsonData.submission['consent_audit'] = {

function updateBannerPosition() {
if (!banner || !bannerVisible) return;
const topObstacles = [
document.querySelector('.dfp-leaderboard-container [style*="position: fixed"]'),
document.querySelector('.dfp-leaderboard-container [id^="bordeaux-ad-"]'),
document.querySelector('.dfp-leaderboard-container'),
document.querySelector('[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead"]'),
document.querySelector('nav.primary-nav'),
document.querySelector('.navigation__container')
];
let maxBottomOffset = 0;
topObstacles.forEach(el => {
if (el) {
const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
const isVisible = style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
if (isVisible && rect.height > 0 && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < 300) {
maxBottomOffset = Math.max(maxBottomOffset, rect.bottom);
}
}
});
banner.style.top = `${Math.max(0, maxBottomOffset)}px`;
banner.style.marginTop = '0px';

if (adContainer || headerContainer) {
const instantObserver = new MutationObserver(triggerInstantUpdate);
const observerConfig = {
childList: true,
subtree: true,
attributes: true,
attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
};
if (adContainer) instantObserver.observe(adContainer, observerConfig);
if (headerContainer) instantObserver.observe(headerContainer, observerConfig);
}
const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(triggerInstantUpdate);
resizeObserver.observe(document.body);
resizeObserver.observe(document.documentElement);

<script>
(function () {
const CONFIG = window.__fteSourcepointConsentConfig ?? {};
const CONSENT_STORAGE_PREFIX = '_sp_user_consent_';
const LOG_BADGE = ['%c FTE ', 'background: #9306F9; color: #ffffff'];
const MAX_SHARD_RETRIES = 3;
const SHARD_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 250;
const safeJsonParse = (value) => {
if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value) return null;
try {
return JSON.parse(value);
} catch {
return null;
}
};
const safeJsonStringify = (value) => {
try {
return JSON.stringify(value ?? {});
} catch {
return '{}';
}
};
const safeDecode = (value) => {
try {
return decodeURIComponent(value);
} catch {
return value;
}
};
const getCookie = (name) => {
if (!document.cookie) return null;
const escaped = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${escaped}=([^;]*)`));
return match ? safeDecode(match[1]) : null;
};
const getStorage = (key) => {
try {
return window.localStorage?.getItem(key) ?? null;
} catch {
return null;
}
};
const getPath = (source, path) =>
path.reduce((acc, key) => (acc && typeof acc === 'object' ? acc[key] : null), source) ??
null;
const normalizeBoolean = (value) => {
if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
if (value === 'true') return true;
if (value === 'false') return false;
return null;
};
const normalizeString = (value) => {
if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
return String(value);
};
const isPresent = (value) => value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '';
const firstPresent = (candidates) =>
candidates.find((c) => isPresent(c.value)) ?? { value: null, source: '' };
const getSourcepointStorage = () => {
const preferred = CONFIG.propertyId
? `${CONSENT_STORAGE_PREFIX}${CONFIG.propertyId}`
: null;
const candidateKeys = new Set(preferred ? [preferred] : []);
try {
const ls = window.localStorage;
if (ls) {
for (let i = 0; i < ls.length; i += 1) {
const key = ls.key(i);
if (key?.startsWith(CONSENT_STORAGE_PREFIX)) candidateKeys.add(key);
}
}
} catch {
/* localStorage blocked */
}
for (const key of candidateKeys) {
const parsed = safeJsonParse(getStorage(key));
if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') return { key, value: parsed };
}

};
const CONSENT_SCHEMA = {
gdpr: {
uuid: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['gdpr', 'uuid']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.gdpr.uuid` : '',
},
{
value: ctx.messageType === 'gdpr' ? (ctx.consentUUID ?? null) : null,
source: 'onConsentReady.consentUUID',
},
{ value: getCookie('consentUUID'), source: 'cookie.consentUUID' },
],
consent_string: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['gdpr', 'euconsent']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.gdpr.euconsent` : '',
},
{
value: ctx.messageType === 'gdpr' ? (ctx.euconsent ?? null) : null,
source: 'onConsentReady.euconsent',
},
{ value: getCookie('euconsent-v2'), source: 'cookie.euconsent-v2' },
],
applies: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: normalizeBoolean(getPath(storage.value, ['gdpr', 'applies'])),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.gdpr.applies` : '',
},
{
value:
ctx.messageType === 'gdpr'
? normalizeBoolean(getPath(ctx.info, ['applies']))
: null,
source: 'onConsentReady.info.applies',
},
],
},
usnat: {
uuid: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'uuid']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.usnat.uuid` : '',
},
{
value: ctx.messageType === 'usnat' ? (ctx.consentUUID ?? null) : null,
source: 'onConsentReady.consentUUID',
},
{ value: getCookie('usnatUUID'), source: 'cookie.usnatUUID' },
],
consent_string: ({ storage }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'consentString']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.usnat.consentString` : '',
},
],
applies: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: normalizeBoolean(getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'applies'])),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.usnat.applies` : '',
},
{
value:
ctx.messageType === 'usnat'
? normalizeBoolean(getPath(ctx.info, ['applies']))
: null,
source: 'onConsentReady.info.applies',
},
],
gpc_enabled: ({ storage }) => [
{
value: normalizeBoolean(getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'gpcEnabled'])),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.usnat.gpcEnabled` : '',

],
},

...(winner.source ? { [`${name}_source`]: winner.source } : {}),
};

const buildSourcepointMeta = () => {
const numericId = Number(CONFIG.propertyId);
return {
account_id: CONFIG.accountId,
property_href: CONFIG.propertyHref ?? '',
base_endpoint: CONFIG.baseEndpoint ?? '',
...(Number.isFinite(numericId) && CONFIG.propertyId !== null

const buildUserIds = () => {

'hybridId',
'value',

isPresent(gaClientId) ? { type: 'TYPE_GA', value: gaClientId } : null,
isPresent(hybridId) ? { type: 'TYPE_HYBRID', value: hybridId } : null,
].filter(Boolean);
};
const buildPayload = (ctx) => {
const storage = getSourcepointStorage();
return {
event_id: `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
captured_at: new Date().toISOString(),
trigger: ctx.trigger,
message_type: ctx.messageType ?? '',
sourcepoint: buildSourcepointMeta(),
gdpr: buildConsent(CONSENT_SCHEMA.gdpr, ctx, storage),
usnat: buildConsent(CONSENT_SCHEMA.usnat, ctx, storage),
user_ids: buildUserIds(),
page: {
url: window.location.href,
hostname: window.location.hostname,
path: window.location.pathname,
referrer: document.referrer ?? '',
},
callback_data: {
choice_id: normalizeString(ctx.choiceId),
choice_type_id: normalizeString(ctx.choiceTypeId),
info_json: safeJsonStringify(ctx.info),

};

const hasShardedUuid = ({ gdpr, usnat }) =>
Boolean(gdpr?.uuid?.includes('_') || usnat?.uuid?.includes('_'));
const isFreyrEnabled = () => Boolean(window.vanilla?.featureFlags?.freyr?.enabled);
const ensureFreyrQueue = () => {
window.freyr = window.freyr || { cmd: [] };
if (!Array.isArray(window.freyr.cmd)) {
window.freyr.cmd = [];
}
};
const send = (payload) => {
if (!isFreyrEnabled()) {
console.warn(...LOG_BADGE, 'Sourcepoint consent event dropped: Freyr disabled');
return;
}
ensureFreyrQueue();
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'sourcepointConsentCapturedEvent',
eventObject: payload,
});
};
const captureAndSend = (ctx, attempt = 0) => {
const payload = buildPayload(ctx);
const shouldRetry =
ctx.trigger === 'CONSENT_EVENT_TRIGGER_ON_MESSAGE_CHOICE_SELECT' &&
attempt < MAX_SHARD_RETRIES &&
!hasShardedUuid(payload);
if (shouldRetry) {
window.setTimeout(() => captureAndSend(ctx, attempt + 1), SHARD_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
return;
}
send(payload);
};
window.fteSourcepointConsentEvent = {
captureAndSend: (ctx = {}) => {
try {
captureAndSend(ctx, 0);
} catch (error) {
console.warn(
...LOG_BADGE,
'Sourcepoint consent event failed',
error?.message ?? error,
);
}
},
};
})();

(function() {
const QA_BASE_URL = 'public.rtb-qa-eks-euw1.futureplc.engineering';
const createScriptTag = (src) => {
const script = document.createElement('script');
script.setAttribute('src', src);
script.setAttribute('onerror', 'handleHeaderError()');
script.setAttribute('crossorigin', 'anonymous');
script.defer = true;
return script;
};
const appendScriptTags = (qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion) => {
if (window.disableBordeaux === true) return;
const bordeauxUrl = qaBordeauxVersion
? `https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js?version=${qaBordeauxVersion}`
: 'https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js';
const champagneUrl = qaChampagneVersion
? `https://chmp.${qaChampagneVersion}.${QA_BASE_URL}/champagne.js`
: 'https://champagne.futurecdn.net/champagne.js';
document.head.append(
createScriptTag(bordeauxUrl),
createScriptTag(champagneUrl)
);
};
const getQueryParams = () => {
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
return {
qaBordeauxVersion: params.get('hybrid_bordeaux_version') ?? null,
qaChampagneVersion: params.get('hybrid_champagne_version') ?? null,
};
};
const { qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion } = getQueryParams();
appendScriptTags(qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion);
if (qaBordeauxVersion) {
window.bordeaux.cmd.push(() => window.bordeaux.setAdToolVersion(qaBordeauxVersion));
}
})();
</script>
